THE OPPORTUNITY

We're seeking an experienced Warehouse Team Leader to join our operations team at our state-of-the-art facility in Gent Zeehaven. This is a hands-on leadership role where you'll guide, inspire, and work alongside a dedicated team of warehouse professionals while ensuring operational excellence in our fast-paced international logistics environment.

YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Team Leadership: Coach and motivate warehouse staff to consistently achieve operational KPIs and quality standards

Operational Planning: Create efficient work schedules, allocate resources, and optimize workflow processes

Hands-On Management: Lead by example - work directly with your team using forklifts and warehouse equipment when needed

Performance Management: Monitor team performance, provide feedback, and implement improvement initiatives

Critical Decision Making: Make quick, effective decisions during peak periods and tight deadline situations

Safety & Compliance: Ensure all safety protocols and quality standards are maintained at all times

Reporting: Provide regular updates to warehouse supervisors and operational management

Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to enhance efficiency and reduce operational costs

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

Essential Requirements:

3+ years of team leadership experience in warehouse, logistics, or distribution environments

Forklift certification (or commitment to obtain certification within 30 days)

Strong communication skills in Dutch and English (French is a plus)

Proven track record of meeting KPIs and managing operational deadlines

Physical stamina for hands-on warehouse work and extended periods on your feet

Flexible schedule - ability to work various shifts including occasional weekends

Problem-solving mindset with ability to make decisions under pressure

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or related field or equal through experience

Experience with WMS (Warehouse Management Systems)

Knowledge of customs procedures and international shipping

Lean/Six Sigma certification or continuous improvement experience

Multilingual capabilities for our international client base

Ready to kick-start your logistics career? On behalf of our client Katoen Natie, we're seeking motivated Order Pickers / Warehouse Employees for their dynamic operations in Gent Zeehaven. This is a temporary contract with excellent potential for permanent employment - your chance to prove yourself while learning from industry experts.

As an order picker, you'll be a crucial link in the international logistics chain, handling valuable materials and ensuring smooth operations for clients worldwide. This versatile role offers the perfect opportunity to develop your skills in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.

• 

• YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Order Picking: Accurately collect goods from warehouse locations using picking lists and handheld scanners

Quality Control: Inspect items for damage and ensure correct quantities before processing

Packing & Preparation: Prepare orders for shipping, including proper packaging and labeling

Receiving: Unload deliveries, check incoming goods, and update inventory systems

Inventory Management: Organize stock locations and maintain warehouse cleanliness

Safety Compliance: Follow all safety protocols and maintain a secure working environment

Team Collaboration: Work effectively with colleagues across different shifts

Continuous Improvement: Suggest ways to optimize processes and increase efficiency

• Essential Requirements:
Basic logistics experience (warehouse, order picking, packing, production) OR strong willingness to learn

Enthusiastic attitude combined with a hands-on mentality - ready to roll up your sleeves!

Reliability and punctuality - your team depends on you

Eye for detail and quality - accuracy is crucial in our operations

Physical fitness - comfortable standing, walking, and lifting throughout your shift

Availability for 2-shift system (early and late shifts)

Basic Dutch or English communication skills

What Makes You Stand Out:

Experience with warehouse management systems (WMS) or scanning equipment

Forklift or reach truck certification (or willingness to obtain)

Previous experience in international logistics or port operations

Multilingual skills for our diverse, international workplace

Positive team player attitude with problem-solving mindset

Do you have experience as a forklift driver?As the driver of the forklift truck with long forks, you are responsible for storing goods and loading/unloading the trucks. Profile

• Physical work doesn't put you off, you like to roll up your sleeves

Take the next step in your accounting career within an international real estate environment. An exciting opportunity is available for an experienced Senior Accountant with a background in Property Management or Real Estate, looking to take on a hands-on and autonomous role within an international property group.

This position goes beyond traditional accounting responsibilities. You will play an important role in ensuring the continuity of daily accounting operations while bringing your expertise to the optimisation of existing processes and financial systems. Working directly with the Finance Manager and senior management, you will have the opportunity to challenge current practices, make recommendations and contribute to the development of a more efficient accounting environment.

This opportunity is particularly suited to an experienced accounting professional who combines strong technical knowledge with professional maturity, initiative and the ability to adapt to an evolving organisation.

As a Senior Accountant, you will:

• Take ownership of day-to-day accounting operations, ensuring accuracy, efficiency and compliance with internal procedures.
• Handle supplier invoices, customer billing, payment processing and general ledger entries.
• Monitor accounting transactions and ensure the accuracy and consistency of financial records.
• Manage accounting activities related to property operations, ensuring reliable financial information and appropriate follow-up.
• Work with Microsoft Dynamics 365 and its associated accounting functionalities and systems.
• Review existing accounting processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reliability and reporting quality.
• Challenge established practices and make constructive recommendations to optimise accounting workflows.
• Work closely with the Finance Manager to ensure continuity across accounting activities and support the smooth running of the finance function.
• Contribute to process optimisation, system improvements and ongoing transformation initiatives.
• Support the development and implementation of improved accounting procedures and working methods.
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure efficient financial operations and effective communication.

About You : 

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field.
• You have approximately 5 to 10 years of relevant professional experience in accounting. More experienced candidates are also welcome.
• You have previous experience in Property Management, Real Estate, property development or a related environment. This is considered a strong advantage.
• You possess solid knowledge of general accounting operations, including supplier accounting, customer invoicing, payment processing and general ledger activities.
• You have experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365. Knowledge of similar ERP systems is also valuable.
• You communicate fluently in both French and English. Knowledge of Dutch is considered a plus.
• You are highly autonomous and comfortable taking ownership of accounting responsibilities from day one.
• You demonstrate professional maturity and have the confidence to challenge existing processes, identify inefficiencies and make constructive recommendations.
• You are comfortable combining hands-on accounting responsibilities with process optimisation and change management initiatives.
• You are a quick learner who can adapt easily to new systems, procedures and organisational requirements.
• You demonstrate strong analytical skills, attention to detail and the ability to maintain high standards of accuracy and quality.
• You are proactive, pragmatic and solution-oriented, with the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with different stakeholders.

Put on your work shoes and kickstart your career in the ice cream industry! 

Are you a go-getter with a heart for quality? At Jacques IJs in Oevel (Westerlo), a proud 100% independent family-owned business, the most delicious ice creams, sorbets, and popsicles roll off the production line for the entire European market.

We are not looking for numbers, but for motivated colleagues who want to grow with us in a modern, pleasant production environment (no freezing cold temperatures!).

Send your CV to talentcenter4@randstad.be or apply directly. Our AI-agent will contact you via WhatsApp to ask a few quick screening questions, and our consultant will follow up on your application.

VG458/BUOSAP

Have you worked in a production or packaging environment before? That first experience is a big plus! But above all, we are looking for the right mindset:

• Drive: You are accurate, involved, and ready to roll up your sleeves.
• Ambition to grow: You are someone who wants to eventually grow into roles such as Operator or Line Supervisor.
• Flexibility: Working the night shift is ideal for you.
• Communication: You speak English well enough to ensure safe cooperation on the work floor.
• Mobility: You have your own transport (car, scooter, or bicycle), as the site in Oevel is difficult to reach by public transport.
As a Production Worker / Packer, you are the final, crucial link. You make sure every ice cream leaves the factory in perfect condition:

• Accurate packing: You pack various ice cream products according to the highest standards.
• Quality check: You have an eagle eye and check if all labels and packaging are 100% correct.
• Team spirit: You support your colleagues and keep the production line running smoothly.
• Ready for shipment: You cross the t's and dot the i's so that all of Europe can enjoy our ice creams.

Do you melt for ice cream? The sweetest challenge in Westerlo awaits you!

Forget about chilly factory environments where you are just a number. At Jacques IJs in Oevel (Westerlo) it's all about a great atmosphere, amazing taste, and teamwork. We produce the most delicious ice creams, sorbets, and water ice for the entire European market. And don't worry: you won't need to wear a heavy winter coat. Our modern production area has a very comfortable temperature; we leave the freezing cold inside the freezers!

Because we are growing rapidly, we are looking for a Production Worker / Packer with passion, energy, and above all: the ambition to grow with us.

Send your CV to talentcenter4@randstad.be or apply directly. Our AI-agent will contact you via WhatsApp to ask a few quick screening questions, and our consultant will follow up on your application.

VG458/BUOSAP

Do you already have experience in a production environment? Great! If not? No problem at all, your mindset is what matters most.

• You want to move forward: Today you start at the packing line, but you dream of growing into an Operator or Line Manager role. We will give you that opportunity!
• Flexible mindset: Working in a 2-shift system fits your lifestyle perfectly.
• Accurate & driven: You know how to work hard, but you never lose sight of the details.
• Fluent in English: Good communication with your colleagues is essential for a safe and smooth workflow.
• Mobile: You have your own car, scooter, or bicycle (unfortunately, our site in Oevel is very difficult to reach by public transport).

You are the crucial final link before our creations head out into the world. Your mission:

• Masterful packing: You ensure that every ice cream comes off the conveyor belt neatly and securely packed.
• The eagle eye: Quality is king! You do lightning-fast checks to ensure all labels and packaging are 100% correct.
• The engine of the line: Together with your colleagues, you keep the energy high and the machines running smoothly.
• Ready for departure: You prepare the finished products for shipment, ensuring that all of Europe can enjoy our ice cream soon.

• Storing products in the correct warehouse locations.

• You are comfortable working with numbers and counting accurately.

• You are available to start at short notice.

• You are willing to perform various warehouse tasks, including operating the reach truck, order picking and checking goods.

jobs.occupation: IT & Cyber Permanent Control Officer - HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

Join BNP Paribas Fortis as an IT Operational Permanent Control (OPC) Specialist At BNP Paribas Fortis, our Cyber Security division unites the Centre of Excellence (CoE) Security and IT Filiere Production Security BE to design, implement, and maintain robust security solutions. Our mission? To foster a trustworthy, secure environment for both our colleagues and clients.

We’re seeking a proactive professional to join our IT Operational Permanent Control (OPC) team, a key function within Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC). Here, you’ll play a pivotal role in helping IT and Business Units navigate operational risks tied to IT and Cyber Security, while reinforcing an adaptive, resilient control framework across the bank.

 

AND IN DETAIL

• Identification and assessment of risks: You’ll analyse data from risk systems, reports, and governance bodies, turning complex information into practical, risk-based insights. Your conclusions will help leaders make informed decisions.
• Controls Execution & Reporting: You’ll interpret, adapt, and run control tests (compliance, fraud, outsourcing, etc.), then report findings to the CIO, ensuring controls align with IT’s strategic priorities.
• Regulatory & Internal Reporting: You’ll prepare precise, high-impact reports for the Internal Control Committee (ExCo), regulators (NBB/BNB, ECB), and Group entities (CDF/IT Group), shaping risk discussions at the highest level.
• Procedure Governance: As the gatekeeper for IT risk and security procedures, you’ll ensure they’re up to date, accessible, and visible, keeping our compliance framework structured and resilient.
• Governance Body Support: Acting as NAC secretary for major IT initiatives, you’ll track stakeholder conditions (Business & Functions), driving accountability and alignment in high-impact projects.
• Risk & Control Self-Assessment (RCSA): You’ll conduct the annual RCSA for all IT risk categories, using the RISK ORM methodology to assess risks, incidents, and recommendations, giving a full picture of IT’s risk profile, including external threats.
• Regulatory Reporting – IT Risk Questionnaire: You’ll coordinate the bank’s response to the ECB’s IT Risk questionnaire (via Group) and the NBB’s BNP Paribas Fortis reporting, ensuring submissions are accurate, regulator-ready, and endorsed by the CISO/CIO.
• Compliance Controls Execution: You’ll run IT-wide compliance checks (awareness, ethics, etc.), report findings to the IT Management Team, and drive remediation where needed, ensuring actions are documented and evidenced.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

Background & Experience

• A Master’s degree in IT, economics, or engineering, with a strong IT foundation.
• 10+ years of experience, including at least 5 years in Risk or IT whether in financial services, consulting, or another regulated industry.  
What You Bring to the Table

• IT & Security Process Insight: You understand how IT and security technologies integrate into risk and operational frameworks and where the gaps might be.
• Risk Assessment Skills: Hands-on experience in identifying and evaluating IT and cyber risks, with a practical (not just theoretical) approach.
• Regulatory & Standards Know-How: Familiarity with frameworks like EBA guidelines, DORA, ISO 27001, or NIST and the ability to apply them in real-world IT risk and compliance scenarios.
• Control Design & Testing: You can translate regulations and policies into effective controls and know how to test whether they actually work.
• Agile Mindset: Experience with Agile methodologies in a risk or control environment is a plus, but adaptability matters most.
• Process Thinking: You quickly grasp end-to-end processes, spot risks, and propose practical solutions without getting lost in bureaucracy.
• Clear Communication: Whether it’s a report for executives or a presentation for regulators, you distill complex topics into concise, actionable messages.
• Stakeholder Alignment: You bridge the gap between technical teams, business units, and regulators keeping everyone aligned without losing sight of compliance and risk goals.
• Collaboration: You thrive in cross-functional teams, working smoothly with colleagues and partners to execute risk and control initiatives.  
Practicalities

• Languages: Fluent in French or Dutch, with strong English (written and spoken).
• Tools: Comfortable with SharePoint, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
• Nice-to-have: Experience with RISK 360 is a plus, but not a must.
